notes: Modular wireless intercom base station; supports 5 or 25 beltpacks depending on license/variant (FSII-BASE-II vs FSII-BASE-II-5), with 1.9GHz and 2.4GHz active transceivers. Headset jack ships as either 4-pin XLR-M (X4 variant, e.g. FSII-BASE-II) or 5-pin XLR-F (X5 variant, e.g. FSII-BASE-II-5-X5) - modeled here as XLR3 4-pin/5-pin family; represented with xlr3 as closest listed id since xlr4/xlr5 output-only options aren't distinguished for headset use (note: schema does include xlr5 - used for the 5-pin variant port, kept 4-pin variant as its own port for completeness, both present as alternates). GPIO port is a DB15 connector (2 GPI / 4 GPO relay-style) - no exact DB15 id exists in the allowed connector list; approximated as rs232 (closest D-sub serial-family connector) per instructions. Transceiver/splitter ports (2x RJ45 + 2x SFP, only 2 active at a time) and DECT/RF sync ports (RJ45) are proprietary Clear-Com transceiver links, not standard Ethernet data ports, but use RJ45/SFP hardware so are graded to eth-1g as a reasonable floor per Clear-Com network cabling guidance (Cat5e/6 shielded); actual internal link speed is not published. DC power input is a locking 4-pin connector (KPJX-4S-S, 12V/60W/5A) supplied via external "wall-wart" style PSU - approximated as dc-barrel per instructions since no locking-DC id exists. Dimensions confirmed as 1RU, 44 x 483 x 312mm from manufacturer manual.
